meta.source: Extracted from the production CSS of raycast.com on 2026-10-30; restyled to Apple Liquid Glass on 2026-10-30

tokens.name: grey-50
tokens.usage: Lightest neutral. Inverted surfaces, text on very dark glass.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Secondary text on grey-900 where fg-200 feels too cool.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Muted copy, icon default state.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels. 3.7:1 on grey-900: large text or non-text only.

tokens.name: grey-400
tokens.usage: Strong dividers, scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Control borders on raised surfaces.

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: Raised surface: menus, popovers.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Card surface, gradient start.

tokens.name: grey-800
tokens.usage: Card gradient end, sunken wells.

tokens.name: grey-900
tokens.usage: Page background. The near-black ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Alias of grey-900: the page background.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: First elevation above the page: sections, list rows.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Second elevation: input fields, selected rows. Also the text colour on the white button.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover fill on bg-200 controls, keycap tops.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Pressed fill, sliders and toggles off-state.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on any bg token. 18.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: fg-200
tokens.usage: Body copy under headings, nav links at rest.

tokens.name: fg-300
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, timestamps. 4.6:1 on bg: the floor for small text.

tokens.name: fg-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative hints only. 3.2:1 on bg: fails for body text, kept from the source.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline between sections and around cards.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Hover state of the primary button; specular highlights.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Window shadows and full-bleed media letterbox.

tokens.name: button-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: white at 82% so the page tints it slightly.

tokens.name: button-fg
tokens.usage: Text on button-bg.

tokens.name: button-hover-bg
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons and list rows: white at 10%.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: The identity hue. Logo mark, hero glows, focus highlights in marketing art. Use sparingly in UI.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: red-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind red text in error badges (15%).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Warnings, 'Pro' and 'New' highlights, syntax step 1.

tokens.name: yellow-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind yellow badge text (15%).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success, enabled, 'Installed'.

tokens.name: green-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind green badge text (15%).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links inside prose, info states, syntax step 5.

tokens.name: blue-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind blue badge text, selected-row tint (15%).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: AI features and keywords in code (syntax step 2).

tokens.name: window-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the command-palette window mock and app frames.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular Liquid Glass fill (white at 4%). Thin on purpose: the backdrop should stay visible through it.

tokens.name: glass-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Regular glass under the pointer (white at 9%).

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass fill (white at 1%) for controls over rich media. Pair with glass-dim behind text.

tokens.name: glass-fill-prominent
tokens.usage: Prominent glass: the primary action. White at 85% so the backdrop still tints it.

tokens.name: glass-fill-tint
tokens.usage: Brand-tinted glass (brand-red at 25%). One tinted control per view at most.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: Top-left rim of every glass surface (white at 30%). Keep it faint: it should read as a catch of light, not an outline.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Bottom-right rim, where light exits the glass (white at 8%).

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Inner top sheen and the pointer-following highlight (white at 12%).

tokens.name: glass-shade
tokens.usage: Soft shadow under floating glass (black at 35%).

tokens.name: glass-dim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer under clear glass so text keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque stand-in for glass when Reduce Transparency is on.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section heroes. Inter with ss02 + ss08 on, liga off.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: It's not about saving time. It's about feeling like you're never wasting it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Search files, launch apps and run scripts from one bar.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Quicklinks open your most visited pages with a keystroke.
styles.usage: The workhorse size: most UI copy, nav links, list rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and list section headers.

styles.name: numeral-mono
styles.usage: Big mono numerals in stats and timers.

styles.name: serif-accent
styles.usage: One italic phrase inside a headline. Never a whole paragraph.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside keycaps and badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (small), row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap; navbar inset; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Input padding; between a title and its description.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap (tight); card inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap (default).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pricing plan padding; large card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding-block on tablet.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding-block on desktop.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Hero top offset.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keycaps, inputs, copy buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, menus, dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, media frames.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards, pricing plans.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Navbar capsule.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Hero showcase panels.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Floating glass panels (command palette, sheets). Rows inside use radius-window minus their inset (concentric).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: every Liquid Glass control (buttons, search fields, navbar, badges, toggles).

shadow.note: Depth comes from a 1px inner top highlight, not from big drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight
tokens.usage: The signature. Top edge of every raised surface: cards, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Same edge on secondary surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Secondary (outlined) button: lit top, ring, dark bottom lip.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Keycap outline.

tokens.name: shadow-card-glow
tokens.usage: Featured cards: a faint periwinkle halo.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Floating windows: command palette, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on any control.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every floating glass surface: lift, contact shadow, inner top light, inner bottom shade, a hairline and an inner glow that gives the glass thickness.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-pressed
tokens.usage: Glass control while pressed: closer to the page.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-contrast
tokens.usage: Glass outline when Increase Contrast is on.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii used for glass surfaces.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Frosting behind overlays on media.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Tooltips, small popovers.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Navbar capsule.

tokens.name: blur-xl
tokens.usage: Command palette window.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Regular glass backdrop blur. Low, so the backdrop stays recognisable and refraction reads.

tokens.name: glass-blur-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass backdrop blur.

tokens.name: container-xs
tokens.usage: Prose, legal pages.

tokens.name: container-sm
tokens.usage: Feature grids.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Default page width and the navbar.

tokens.name: container-lg
tokens.usage: Full-bleed showcases.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: Navbar capsule height (76px on large screens).

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost: colour behind glass reads richer, as through a lens.

tokens.name: glass-brightness
tokens.usage: Backdrop brightness lift on regular glass.

tokens.name: glass-refraction
tokens.usage: Edge refraction strength in px (displacement scale) used by glass.js.

tokens.name: glass-bezel
tokens.usage: Width in px of the refracting edge band used by glass.js.

tokens.name: glass-press-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of an interactive glass control while pressed.

tokens.name: glass-dispersion
tokens.usage: Chromatic split at the refracting edge: red and blue are displaced this much more and less than green (glass.js).
